title: Coverage-Year Accounting Note: What the Plan Drew in the Coverage Year Just Ended
content:
What a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans drew in the coverage year just ended is read from the settlements booked to it, over a period fixed by the allowance entries standing on the plan and by whether the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year.

Where allowance entries stand on the plan and the coverage grants its allowance afresh each year, what the plan drew is the benefit consumed by the settlements booked in the 12 months following the most recent allowance entry. Where allowance entries stand on the plan and the coverage does not grant its allowance afresh each year, what the plan drew is the benefit consumed by every settlement booked to the plan. In any other case what the plan drew is the benefit consumed by the settlements booked in the 12 months to the handling date.

## Which period is read

| Allowance entries standing on the plan | The coverage grants its allowance afresh each year | What the plan drew |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | yes | the benefit consumed by the settlements booked in the 12 months following the most recent allowance entry |
| one or more | no | the benefit consumed by every settlement booked to the plan |
| none | either | the benefit consumed by the settlements booked in the 12 months to the handling date |

Settlements stand on the plan as movements out of the allowance, so the benefit they consumed is read as the size of those movements.

## Which plans grant afresh

| Plan | The yearly allowance is granted afresh each year |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | no |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | yes |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | yes |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | yes |
